sources.note: Main website. Sparse — describes Universal EHR as an EHR and practice management system for all sized practices. Lists version 2.0.0, mentions customization, remote access, MFA, API access. Mandatory disclosures URL also points here.

Patient portal login page. Lists affiliated healthcare providers (DAO Medical Group, BAN DUC DOAN, Reform24 Medical Group, Southern California Vein and Wound Care Center). Shows patient lookup by name, DOB, or SSN last 4. Includes patient photo display and security question verification.
Real World Testing page. Links to RWT plans and results documents from 2021-2025. Confirms product is called UniversalEHR.
Interoperability Engine / API terms of use page (referenced from main site). Indicates API/interoperability capabilities.
Superbill PDF linked to DAO Medical Group. Could not extract content but filename suggests billing/superbill generation capability.

LinkedIn company page. Lists 11-50 employees (though only 3 visible), founded 2005, privately held, Hospitals and Health Care industry. Describes Physician's Solution as the core product. Website listed as uniehr.com.
LinkedIn profile for Binh Pham, Software Developer at UniversalEHR.com, located in Garden Grove area.
LinkedIn profile for Michael M. Dao, MD. Listed as associated with Dao Medical Group AND universalEHR.com, suggesting a business relationship between the primary customer and the vendor.

2011 press release: Physician's Solution 5.0 at HIMSS11. Describes browser-based EHR, Complete EHR certification, rapid deployment, preferred vendor of FL ACC chapter, customer Telemedik (Puerto Rico). Lists product suite: Physician's Portal, Patient Direct, Doctor Direct, MedRecordsAlert, Hospital's Solution.

2011 press release: Customized, Flexible EHR solution. Details Physician's Solution features: customizable modules for 12+ specialties, turnkey or interfaces with PM/billing, HL7/XML bidirectional, smartphone support, Hospital's Solution 'three-in-one package'. Company leadership: Aaron Wachspress (CTO), Mitchell C. Shapiro (President).
MedicalRecords.com listing for Universal EHR Solutions / Physician's Solution. Page did not render meaningful content when fetched.
DAO Medical Group patient portal page — directs patients to Universal EHR login, confirming they are an active customer.
HealthGrades listing for DAO Medical Group — Garden Grove/Westminster CA area, confirming geographic co-location with Universal EHR developer.
